   118	// Small and medium problems do not contain enough bodies to occupy a modern
   119	// GPU with one thread per body. Here a power-of-two group of lanes cooperates
   120	// on each body's force and reduces its partial sums with warp shuffles.
   121	template <int LANES_PER_BODY, int BLOCK_SIZE>
   122	__global__ __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_SIZE)
   123	void advanceBodiesCooperative(const double* __restrict__ inX,
   124	                              const double* __restrict__ inY,
   125	                              const double* __restrict__ inZ,
   126	                              double* __restrict__ outX,
   127	                              double* __restrict__ outY,
   128	                              double* __restrict__ outZ,
   129	                              double* __restrict__ velX,
   130	                              double* __restrict__ velY,
   131	                              double* __restrict__ velZ,
   132	                              const int n) {
   133	    constexpr unsigned int FULL_WARP_MASK = 0xffffffffu;
   134	    const int globalThread = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * BLOCK_SIZE + static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
   135	    const int bodyIndex = globalThread / LANES_PER_BODY;
   136	    const int lane = globalThread & (LANES_PER_BODY - 1);
   137	    const bool active = bodyIndex < n;
   138	    const double bodyX = active ? inX[bodyIndex] : 0.0;
   139	    const double bodyY = active ? inY[bodyIndex] : 0.0;
   140	    const double bodyZ = active ? inZ[bodyIndex] : 0.0;
   141	    double forceX = 0.0;
   142	    double forceY = 0.0;
   143	    double forceZ = 0.0;
   144	
   145	    if (active) {
   146	#pragma unroll 4
   147	        for (int j = lane; j < n; j += LANES_PER_BODY) {
   148	            const double dx = inX[j] - bodyX;
   149	            const double dy = inY[j] - bodyY;
   150	            const double dz = inZ[j] - bodyZ;
   151	            const double distanceSquared = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
   152	            const double inverseDistance = rsqrt(distanceSquared);
   153	            const double inverseDistanceCubed = inverseDistance * inverseDistance * inverseDistance;
   154	            forceX += dx * inverseDistanceCubed;
   155	            forceY += dy * inverseDistanceCubed;
   156	            forceZ += dz * inverseDistanceCubed;
   157	        }
   158	    }
   159	
   160	#pragma unroll
   161	    for (int offset = LANES_PER_BODY / 2; offset > 0; offset /= 2) {
   162	        forceX += __shfl_down_sync(FULL_WARP_MASK, forceX, offset, LANES_PER_BODY);
   163	        forceY += __shfl_down_sync(FULL_WARP_MASK, forceY, offset, LANES_PER_BODY);
   164	        forceZ += __shfl_down_sync(FULL_WARP_MASK, forceZ, offset, LANES_PER_BODY);
   165	    }
   166	
   167	    if (active && lane == 0) {
   168	        const double newVelocityX = velX[bodyIndex] + DT * forceX;
   169	        const double newVelocityY = velY[bodyIndex] + DT * forceY;
   170	        const double newVelocityZ = velZ[bodyIndex] + DT * forceZ;
   171	        velX[bodyIndex] = newVelocityX;
   172	        velY[bodyIndex] = newVelocityY;
   173	        velZ[bodyIndex] = newVelocityZ;
   174	        outX[bodyIndex] = bodyX + DT * newVelocityX;
   175	        outY[bodyIndex] = bodyY + DT * newVelocityY;
   176	        outZ[bodyIndex] = bodyZ + DT * newVelocityZ;
   177	    }
   178	}
   179	
   180	class CudaSimulation {
   181	  public:
   182	    CudaSimulation(const std::vector<Body>& bodies, const int steps)
   183	        : count_(static_cast<int>(bodies.size())), steps_(steps) {
   184	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&stream_, cudaStreamNonBlocking));
   185	
   186	        if (count_ == 0) {
   187	            return;
   188	        }
   189	
   190	        const size_t componentBytes = static_cast<size_t>(count_) * sizeof(double);
   191	        std::vector<double> hostState(static_cast<size_t>(count_) * 6);
   192	        double* hostPosX = hostState.data();
   193	        double* hostPosY = hostPosX + count_;
   194	        double* hostPosZ = hostPosY + count_;
   195	        double* hostVelX = hostPosZ + count_;
   196	        double* hostVelY = hostVelX + count_;
   197	        double* hostVelZ = hostVelY + count_;
   198	        for (int i = 0; i < count_; ++i) {
   199	            hostPosX[i] = bodies[i].pos.x;
   200	            hostPosY[i] = bodies[i].pos.y;
   201	            hostPosZ[i] = bodies[i].pos.z;
   202	            hostVelX[i] = bodies[i].vel.x;
   203	            hostVelY[i] = bodies[i].vel.y;
   204	            hostVelZ[i] = bodies[i].vel.z;
   205	        }
   206	
   207	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&deviceState_, static_cast<size_t>(count_) * 9 * sizeof(double)));
   208	        currentX_ = deviceState_;
   209	        currentY_ = currentX_ + count_;
   210	        currentZ_ = currentY_ + count_;
   211	        nextX_ = currentZ_ + count_;
   212	        nextY_ = nextX_ + count_;
   213	        nextZ_ = nextY_ + count_;
   214	        velocityX_ = nextZ_ + count_;
   215	        velocityY_ = velocityX_ + count_;
   216	        velocityZ_ = velocityY_ + count_;
   217	
   218	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(currentX_, hostPosX, componentBytes * 3,
   219	                                   cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream_));
   220	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(velocityX_, hostVelX, componentBytes * 3,
   221	                                   cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream_));
   222	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream_));
   223	        buildExecutionGraph();
   224	    }
   225	
   226	    CudaSimulation(const CudaSimulation&) = delete;
   227	    CudaSimulation& operator=(const CudaSimulation&) = delete;
   228	
   229	    ~CudaSimulation() {
   230	        if (batchGraphExecutable_ != nullptr) {
   231	            cudaGraphExecDestroy(batchGraphExecutable_);
   232	        }
   233	        if (batchGraph_ != nullptr) {
   234	            cudaGraphDestroy(batchGraph_);
   235	        }
   236	        if (tailGraphExecutable_ != nullptr) {
   237	            cudaGraphExecDestroy(tailGraphExecutable_);
   238	        }
   239	        if (tailGraph_ != nullptr) {
   240	            cudaGraphDestroy(tailGraph_);
   241	        }
   242	        if (deviceState_ != nullptr) {
   243	            cudaFree(deviceState_);
   244	        }
   245	        if (stream_ != nullptr) {
   246	            cudaStreamDestroy(stream_);
   247	        }
   248	    }
   249	
   250	    void advance() {
   251	        for (int batch = 0; batch < batchLaunches_; ++batch) {
   252	            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGraphLaunch(batchGraphExecutable_, stream_));
   253	        }
   254	        if (tailGraphExecutable_ != nullptr) {
   255	            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGraphLaunch(tailGraphExecutable_, stream_));
   256	        }
   257	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream_));
   258	    }
   259	
   260	    void copyToHost(std::vector<Body>& bodies) const {
   261	        if (count_ == 0) {
   262	            return;
   263	        }
   264	
   265	        const size_t componentBytes = static_cast<size_t>(count_) * sizeof(double);
   266	        std::vector<double> hostState(static_cast<size_t>(count_) * 6);
   267	        double* hostPosX = hostState.data();
   268	        double* hostPosY = hostPosX + count_;
   269	        double* hostPosZ = hostPosY + count_;
   270	        double* hostVelX = hostPosZ + count_;
   271	        double* hostVelY = hostVelX + count_;
   272	        double* hostVelZ = hostVelY + count_;
   273	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(hostPosX, currentX_, componentBytes * 3,
   274	                                   cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream_));
   275	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(hostVelX, velocityX_, componentBytes * 3,
   276	                                   cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream_));
   277	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream_));
   278	        for (int i = 0; i < count_; ++i) {
   279	            bodies[i].pos.x = hostPosX[i];
   280	            bodies[i].pos.y = hostPosY[i];
   281	            bodies[i].pos.z = hostPosZ[i];
   282	            bodies[i].vel.x = hostVelX[i];
   283	            bodies[i].vel.y = hostVelY[i];
   284	            bodies[i].vel.z = hostVelZ[i];
   285	        }
   286	    }
   287	
   288	  private:
   289	    static constexpr int BLOCK_SIZE = 128;
   290	    static constexpr int GRAPH_BATCH_STEPS = 128;
   291	    // Three 150,000-element position arrays occupy 3.6 MB. Below this point
   292	    // they remain cache-friendly and a warp per body maximizes arithmetic
   293	    // occupancy; beyond it, explicit shared-memory tiling limits DRAM traffic.
   294	    static constexpr int COOPERATIVE_BODY_LIMIT = 150000;
   295	
   296	    template <int LANES_PER_BODY>
   297	    void launchCooperativeStep() {
   298	        const int bodiesPerBlock = BLOCK_SIZE / LANES_PER_BODY;
   299	        const int blocks = (count_ + bodiesPerBlock - 1) / bodiesPerBlock;
   300	        advanceBodiesCooperative<LANES_PER_BODY, BLOCK_SIZE><<<blocks, BLOCK_SIZE, 0, stream_>>>(
   301	            currentX_, currentY_, currentZ_, nextX_, nextY_, nextZ_,
   302	            velocityX_, velocityY_, velocityZ_, count_);
   303	    }
   304	
   305	    void launchStep() {
   306	        if (count_ <= COOPERATIVE_BODY_LIMIT) {
   307	            launchCooperativeStep<32>();
   308	        } else {
   309	            const int blocks = (count_ + BLOCK_SIZE - 1) / BLOCK_SIZE;
   310	            advanceBodiesTiled<BLOCK_SIZE><<<blocks, BLOCK_SIZE, 0, stream_>>>(
   311	                currentX_, currentY_, currentZ_, nextX_, nextY_, nextZ_,
   312	                velocityX_, velocityY_, velocityZ_, count_);
   313	        }
   314	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
   315	        std::swap(currentX_, nextX_);
   316	        std::swap(currentY_, nextY_);
   317	        std::swap(currentZ_, nextZ_);
   318	    }
   319	
   320	    void captureSteps(const int graphSteps, cudaGraph_t* graph, cudaGraphExec_t* executable) {
   321	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamBeginCapture(stream_, cudaStreamCaptureModeThreadLocal));
   322	        for (int step = 0; step < graphSteps; ++step) {
   323	            launchStep();
   324	        }
   325	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamEndCapture(stream_, graph));
   326	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGraphInstantiate(executable, *graph, nullptr, nullptr, 0));
   327	    }
   328	
   329	    void buildExecutionGraph() {
   330	        if (steps_ <= 0) {
   331	            return;
   332	        }
   333	
   334	        if (steps_ <= GRAPH_BATCH_STEPS) {
   335	            captureSteps(steps_, &batchGraph_, &batchGraphExecutable_);
   336	            batchLaunches_ = 1;
   337	        } else {
   338	            // An even-sized graph returns the ping-pong position buffers to
   339	            // their starting orientation, so it can be replayed without
   340	            // constructing an unbounded graph.
   341	            captureSteps(GRAPH_BATCH_STEPS, &batchGraph_, &batchGraphExecutable_);
   342	            batchLaunches_ = steps_ / GRAPH_BATCH_STEPS;
   343	            const int tailSteps = steps_ % GRAPH_BATCH_STEPS;
   344	            if (tailSteps != 0) {
   345	                captureSteps(tailSteps, &tailGraph_, &tailGraphExecutable_);
   346	            }
   347	        }
   348	
   349	        // Upload graph metadata before the benchmark interval, just like the
   350	        // device allocation and initial-state transfer above.
   351	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGraphUpload(batchGraphExecutable_, stream_));
   352	        if (tailGraphExecutable_ != nullptr) {
   353	            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGraphUpload(tailGraphExecutable_, stream_));
   354	        }
   355	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream_));
   356	    }
   357	
   358	    int count_ = 0;
   359	    int steps_ = 0;
   360	    double* deviceState_ = nullptr;
   360	    double* deviceState_ = nullptr;
   361	    double* currentX_ = nullptr;
   362	    double* currentY_ = nullptr;
   363	    double* currentZ_ = nullptr;
   364	    double* nextX_ = nullptr;
   365	    double* nextY_ = nullptr;
   366	    double* nextZ_ = nullptr;
   367	    double* velocityX_ = nullptr;
   368	    double* velocityY_ = nullptr;
   369	    double* velocityZ_ = nullptr;
   370	    cudaStream_t stream_ = nullptr;
   371	    int batchLaunches_ = 0;
   372	    cudaGraph_t batchGraph_ = nullptr;
   373	    cudaGraphExec_t batchGraphExecutable_ = nullptr;
   374	    cudaGraph_t tailGraph_ = nullptr;
   375	    cudaGraphExec_t tailGraphExecutable_ = nullptr;
   376	};
   377	
   378	double computeTotalEnergy(const std::vector<Body>& bodies) {
   379	    double energy = 0.0;
   380	    const size_t n = bodies.size();
   381	
   382	    // Kinetic energy (assuming unit mass)
   383	    for (const auto& body : bodies) {
   384	        energy += 0.5 * (body.vel.x * body.vel.x +
   385	                        body.vel.y * body.vel.y +
   386	                        body.vel.z * body.vel.z);
   387	    }
   388	
   389	    // Potential energy (assuming unit mass for all bodies)
   390	    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
   391	        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {
   392	            const double dx = bodies[j].pos.x - bodies[i].pos.x;
   393	            const double dy = bodies[j].pos.y - bodies[i].pos.y;
   394	            const double dz = bodies[j].pos.z - bodies[i].pos.z;
   395	            const double dist = std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING);
   396	            energy -= 1.0 / dist;
   397	        }
   398	    }
   399	
   400	    return energy;
   401	}
   402	
   403	// Validate that simulation produces finite, reasonable values
   404	bool validateSimulation(const std::vector<Body>& bodies) {
   405	    for (const auto& body : bodies) {
   406	        // Check for NaN or Inf values
   407	        if (!std::isfinite(body.pos.x) || !std::isfinite(body.pos.y) || !std::isfinite(body.pos.z) ||
   408	            !std::isfinite(body.vel.x) || !std::isfinite(body.vel.y) || !std::isfinite(body.vel.z)) {
   409	            printf("Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value in body state\n");
   410	            return false;
   411	        }
   412	
   413	        // Check for extreme values (bodies shouldn't fly off to infinity)
   414	        const double maxPos = 1e6;
   415	        const double maxVel = 1e6;
   416	        if (std::abs(body.pos.x) > maxPos || std::abs(body.pos.y) > maxPos || std::abs(body.pos.z) > maxPos) {
   417	            printf("Validation failed: body position exceeds reasonable bounds\n");
   418	            return false;
   419	        }
   420	        if (std::abs(body.vel.x) > maxVel || std::abs(body.vel.y) > maxVel || std::abs(body.vel.z) > maxVel) {
   421	            printf("Validation failed: body velocity exceeds reasonable bounds\n");
   422	            return false;
   423	        }
   424	    }
   425	    return true;
   426	}
   427	
   428	void printUsage(const char* progName) {
   429	    printf("Usage: %s [options]\n", progName);
   430	    printf("Options:\n");
   431	    printf("  -n <num>     Number of bodies (default: 1024)\n");
   432	    printf("  -s <num>     Number of simulation steps (default: 10)\n");
   433	    printf("  -v           Enable validation (checks energy conservation)\n");
   434	    printf("  -r           Print results for external validation\n");
   435	    printf("  -h           Show this help message\n");
   436	}
   437	
   438	int main(int argc, char** argv) {
   439	    int numBodies = 1024;
   440	    int numSteps = 10;
   441	    bool validate = false;
   442	    bool printResults = false;
   443	
   444	    // Parse command line arguments
   445	    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {
   446	        if (strcmp(argv[i], "-n") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
   447	            numBodies = atoi(argv[++i]);
   448	        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-s") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
   449	            numSteps = atoi(argv[++i]);
   450	        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-v") == 0) {
   451	            validate = true;
   452	        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-r") == 0) {
   453	            printResults = true;
   454	        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-h") == 0) {
   455	            printUsage(argv[0]);
   456	            return 0;
   457	        } else {
   458	            printf("Unknown option: %s\n", argv[i]);
   459	            printUsage(argv[0]);
   460	            return 1;
   461	        }
   462	    }
   463	
   464	    printf("N-Body Simulation\n");
   465	    printf("Number of bodies: %d\n", numBodies);
   466	    printf("Number of steps: %d\n", numSteps);
   467	    printf("Validation: %s\n", validate ? "enabled" : "disabled");
   468	
   469	    // Initialize bodies and upload the structure-of-arrays device state.
   470	    std::vector<Body> bodies(numBodies);
   471	    randomizeBodies(bodies);
   472	    CudaSimulation simulation(bodies, numSteps);
   473	
   474	    // Graph construction and transfers are setup costs; this interval measures
   475	    // the same simulation-step work as the original CPU timer.
   476	    const auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
   477	    simulation.advance();
   478	    const auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
   479	    const auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start);
   480	
   481	    printf("Simulation time: %ld ms\n", duration.count());
   482	
   483	    if (printResults || validate) {
   484	        simulation.copyToHost(bodies);
   485	    }
   486	
   487	    // Print results for external validation
   488	    if (printResults) {
   489	        // Serialize body positions and velocities for hashing
   490	        std::vector<double> bodyData;
   491	        bodyData.reserve(static_cast<size_t>(numBodies) * 6);
   492	        for (const auto& body : bodies) {
   493	            bodyData.push_back(body.pos.x);
   494	            bodyData.push_back(body.pos.y);
   495	            bodyData.push_back(body.pos.z);
   496	            bodyData.push_back(body.vel.x);
   497	            bodyData.push_back(body.vel.y);
   498	            bodyData.push_back(body.vel.z);
   499	        }
   500	        print_results(bodyData, "Bodies");
   501	    }
   502	
   503	    // Validation: check that simulation produces finite, reasonable values
   504	    if (validate) {
   505	        printf("Validating simulation results...\n");
   506	
   507	        if (validateSimulation(bodies)) {
   508	            // Report final energy for reference
   509	            const double finalEnergy = computeTotalEnergy(bodies);
   510	            printf("Final energy: %.6f\n", finalEnergy);
   511	            printf("Validation: PASSED\n");
   512	            return 0;
   513	        }
   514	
   515	        printf("Validation: FAILED\n");
   516	        return 1;
   517	    }
   518	
   519	    return 0;
   520	}

+// For large problems, one thread owns one body. Source positions are staged in
+// shared memory so every global load is reused by the entire thread block.
+template <int BLOCK_SIZE>
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_SIZE)
+void advanceBodiesTiled(const double* __restrict__ inX,
+                        const double* __restrict__ inY,
+                        const double* __restrict__ inZ,
+                        double* __restrict__ outX,
+                        double* __restrict__ outY,
+                        double* __restrict__ outZ,
+                        double* __restrict__ velX,
+                        double* __restrict__ velY,
+                        double* __restrict__ velZ,
+                        const int n) {
+    __shared__ double tileX[BLOCK_SIZE];
+    __shared__ double tileY[BLOCK_SIZE];
+    __shared__ double tileZ[BLOCK_SIZE];
+
+    const int bodyIndex = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * BLOCK_SIZE + static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+    const bool active = bodyIndex < n;
+    const double bodyX = active ? inX[bodyIndex] : 0.0;
+    const double bodyY = active ? inY[bodyIndex] : 0.0;
+    const double bodyZ = active ? inZ[bodyIndex] : 0.0;
+    double forceX = 0.0;
+    double forceY = 0.0;
+    double forceZ = 0.0;
+
+    for (int tileBase = 0; tileBase < n; tileBase += BLOCK_SIZE) {
+        const int sourceIndex = tileBase + static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+        if (sourceIndex < n) {
+            tileX[threadIdx.x] = inX[sourceIndex];
+            tileY[threadIdx.x] = inY[sourceIndex];
+            tileZ[threadIdx.x] = inZ[sourceIndex];
         }
-        
-        bodies[i].vel.x += DT * Fx;
-        bodies[i].vel.y += DT * Fy;
-        bodies[i].vel.z += DT * Fz;
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        if (active) {
+            const int tileCount = min(BLOCK_SIZE, n - tileBase);
+#pragma unroll 8
+            for (int j = 0; j < tileCount; ++j) {
+                const double dx = tileX[j] - bodyX;
+                const double dy = tileY[j] - bodyY;
+                const double dz = tileZ[j] - bodyZ;
+                const double distanceSquared = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
+                const double inverseDistance = rsqrt(distanceSquared);
+                const double inverseDistanceCubed = inverseDistance * inverseDistance * inverseDistance;
+                forceX += dx * inverseDistanceCubed;
+                forceY += dy * inverseDistanceCubed;
+                forceZ += dz * inverseDistanceCubed;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+
+    if (active) {
+        const double newVelocityX = velX[bodyIndex] + DT * forceX;
+        const double newVelocityY = velY[bodyIndex] + DT * forceY;
+        const double newVelocityZ = velZ[bodyIndex] + DT * forceZ;
+        velX[bodyIndex] = newVelocityX;
+        velY[bodyIndex] = newVelocityY;
+        velZ[bodyIndex] = newVelocityZ;
+        outX[bodyIndex] = bodyX + DT * newVelocityX;
+        outY[bodyIndex] = bodyY + DT * newVelocityY;
+        outZ[bodyIndex] = bodyZ + DT * newVelocityZ;
     }

-void integrateBodies(std::vector<Body>& bodies) {
-    for (auto& body : bodies) {
-        body.pos.x += body.vel.x * DT;
-        body.pos.y += body.vel.y * DT;
-        body.pos.z += body.vel.z * DT;
+// Small and medium problems do not contain enough bodies to occupy a modern
+// GPU with one thread per body. Here a power-of-two group of lanes cooperates
+// on each body's force and reduces its partial sums with warp shuffles.
+template <int LANES_PER_BODY, int BLOCK_SIZE>
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_SIZE)
+void advanceBodiesCooperative(const double* __restrict__ inX,
+                              const double* __restrict__ inY,
+                              const double* __restrict__ inZ,
+                              double* __restrict__ outX,
+                              double* __restrict__ outY,
+                              double* __restrict__ outZ,
+                              double* __restrict__ velX,
+                              double* __restrict__ velY,
+                              double* __restrict__ velZ,
+                              const int n) {
+    constexpr unsigned int FULL_WARP_MASK = 0xffffffffu;
+    const int globalThread = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * BLOCK_SIZE + static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+    const int bodyIndex = globalThread / LANES_PER_BODY;
+    const int lane = globalThread & (LANES_PER_BODY - 1);
+    const bool active = bodyIndex < n;
+    const double bodyX = active ? inX[bodyIndex] : 0.0;
+    const double bodyY = active ? inY[bodyIndex] : 0.0;
+    const double bodyZ = active ? inZ[bodyIndex] : 0.0;
+    double forceX = 0.0;
+    double forceY = 0.0;
+    double forceZ = 0.0;
+
+    if (active) {
+#pragma unroll 4
+        for (int j = lane; j < n; j += LANES_PER_BODY) {
+            const double dx = inX[j] - bodyX;
+            const double dy = inY[j] - bodyY;
+            const double dz = inZ[j] - bodyZ;
+            const double distanceSquared = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
+            const double inverseDistance = rsqrt(distanceSquared);
+            const double inverseDistanceCubed = inverseDistance * inverseDistance * inverseDistance;
+            forceX += dx * inverseDistanceCubed;
+            forceY += dy * inverseDistanceCubed;
+            forceZ += dz * inverseDistanceCubed;
+        }
+    }
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int offset = LANES_PER_BODY / 2; offset > 0; offset /= 2) {
+        forceX += __shfl_down_sync(FULL_WARP_MASK, forceX, offset, LANES_PER_BODY);
+        forceY += __shfl_down_sync(FULL_WARP_MASK, forceY, offset, LANES_PER_BODY);
+        forceZ += __shfl_down_sync(FULL_WARP_MASK, forceZ, offset, LANES_PER_BODY);
+    }
+
+    if (active && lane == 0) {
+        const double newVelocityX = velX[bodyIndex] + DT * forceX;
+        const double newVelocityY = velY[bodyIndex] + DT * forceY;
+        const double newVelocityZ = velZ[bodyIndex] + DT * forceZ;
+        velX[bodyIndex] = newVelocityX;
+        velY[bodyIndex] = newVelocityY;
+        velZ[bodyIndex] = newVelocityZ;
+        outX[bodyIndex] = bodyX + DT * newVelocityX;
+        outY[bodyIndex] = bodyY + DT * newVelocityY;
+        outZ[bodyIndex] = bodyZ + DT * newVelocityZ;
     }
 }
 
+class CudaSimulation {
+  public:
+    CudaSimulation(const std::vector<Body>& bodies, const int steps)
+        : count_(static_cast<int>(bodies.size())), steps_(steps) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&stream_, cudaStreamNonBlocking));
+
+        if (count_ == 0) {
+            return;
+        }
+
+        const size_t componentBytes = static_cast<size_t>(count_) * sizeof(double);
+        std::vector<double> hostState(static_cast<size_t>(count_) * 6);
+        double* hostPosX = hostState.data();
+        double* hostPosY = hostPosX + count_;
+        double* hostPosZ = hostPosY + count_;
+        double* hostVelX = hostPosZ + count_;
+        double* hostVelY = hostVelX + count_;
+        double* hostVelZ = hostVelY + count_;
+        for (int i = 0; i < count_; ++i) {
+            hostPosX[i] = bodies[i].pos.x;
+            hostPosY[i] = bodies[i].pos.y;
+            hostPosZ[i] = bodies[i].pos.z;
+            hostVelX[i] = bodies[i].vel.x;
+            hostVelY[i] = bodies[i].vel.y;
+            hostVelZ[i] = bodies[i].vel.z;
+        }
+
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&deviceState_, static_cast<size_t>(count_) * 9 * sizeof(double)));
+        currentX_ = deviceState_;
+        currentY_ = currentX_ + count_;
+        currentZ_ = currentY_ + count_;
+        nextX_ = currentZ_ + count_;
+        nextY_ = nextX_ + count_;
+        nextZ_ = nextY_ + count_;
+        velocityX_ = nextZ_ + count_;
+        velocityY_ = velocityX_ + count_;
+        velocityZ_ = velocityY_ + count_;
+
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(currentX_, hostPosX, componentBytes * 3,
+                                   cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream_));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(velocityX_, hostVelX, componentBytes * 3,
+                                   cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream_));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream_));
+        buildExecutionGraph();
+    }
+
+    CudaSimulation(const CudaSimulation&) = delete;
+    CudaSimulation& operator=(const CudaSimulation&) = delete;
+
+    ~CudaSimulation() {
+        if (batchGraphExecutable_ != nullptr) {
+            cudaGraphExecDestroy(batchGraphExecutable_);
+        }
+        if (batchGraph_ != nullptr) {
+            cudaGraphDestroy(batchGraph_);
+        }
+        if (tailGraphExecutable_ != nullptr) {
+            cudaGraphExecDestroy(tailGraphExecutable_);
+        }
+        if (tailGraph_ != nullptr) {
+            cudaGraphDestroy(tailGraph_);
+        }
+        if (deviceState_ != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(deviceState_);
+        }
+        if (stream_ != nullptr) {
+            cudaStreamDestroy(stream_);
+        }
+    }
+
+    void advance() {
+        for (int batch = 0; batch < batchLaunches_; ++batch) {
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGraphLaunch(batchGraphExecutable_, stream_));
+        }
+        if (tailGraphExecutable_ != nullptr) {
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGraphLaunch(tailGraphExecutable_, stream_));
+        }
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream_));
+    }
+
+    void copyToHost(std::vector<Body>& bodies) const {
+        if (count_ == 0) {
+            return;
+        }
+
+        const size_t componentBytes = static_cast<size_t>(count_) * sizeof(double);
+        std::vector<double> hostState(static_cast<size_t>(count_) * 6);
+        double* hostPosX = hostState.data();
+        double* hostPosY = hostPosX + count_;
+        double* hostPosZ = hostPosY + count_;
+        double* hostVelX = hostPosZ + count_;
+        double* hostVelY = hostVelX + count_;
+        double* hostVelZ = hostVelY + count_;
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(hostPosX, currentX_, componentBytes * 3,
+                                   cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream_));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(hostVelX, velocityX_, componentBytes * 3,
+                                   cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream_));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream_));
+        for (int i = 0; i < count_; ++i) {
+            bodies[i].pos.x = hostPosX[i];
+            bodies[i].pos.y = hostPosY[i];
+            bodies[i].pos.z = hostPosZ[i];
+            bodies[i].vel.x = hostVelX[i];
+            bodies[i].vel.y = hostVelY[i];
+            bodies[i].vel.z = hostVelZ[i];
+        }
+    }
+
+  private:
+    static constexpr int BLOCK_SIZE = 128;
+    static constexpr int GRAPH_BATCH_STEPS = 128;
+    // Three 150,000-element position arrays occupy 3.6 MB. Below this point
+    // they remain cache-friendly and a warp per body maximizes arithmetic
+    // occupancy; beyond it, explicit shared-memory tiling limits DRAM traffic.
+    static constexpr int COOPERATIVE_BODY_LIMIT = 150000;
+
+    template <int LANES_PER_BODY>
+    void launchCooperativeStep() {
+        const int bodiesPerBlock = BLOCK_SIZE / LANES_PER_BODY;
+        const int blocks = (count_ + bodiesPerBlock - 1) / bodiesPerBlock;
+        advanceBodiesCooperative<LANES_PER_BODY, BLOCK_SIZE><<<blocks, BLOCK_SIZE, 0, stream_>>>(
+            currentX_, currentY_, currentZ_, nextX_, nextY_, nextZ_,
+            velocityX_, velocityY_, velocityZ_, count_);
+    }
+
+    void launchStep() {
+        if (count_ <= COOPERATIVE_BODY_LIMIT) {
+            launchCooperativeStep<32>();
+        } else {
+            const int blocks = (count_ + BLOCK_SIZE - 1) / BLOCK_SIZE;
+            advanceBodiesTiled<BLOCK_SIZE><<<blocks, BLOCK_SIZE, 0, stream_>>>(
+                currentX_, currentY_, currentZ_, nextX_, nextY_, nextZ_,
+                velocityX_, velocityY_, velocityZ_, count_);
+        }
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+        std::swap(currentX_, nextX_);
+        std::swap(currentY_, nextY_);
+        std::swap(currentZ_, nextZ_);
+    }
+
+    void captureSteps(const int graphSteps, cudaGraph_t* graph, cudaGraphExec_t* executable) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamBeginCapture(stream_, cudaStreamCaptureModeThreadLocal));
+        for (int step = 0; step < graphSteps; ++step) {
+            launchStep();
+        }
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamEndCapture(stream_, graph));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGraphInstantiate(executable, *graph, nullptr, nullptr, 0));
+    }
+
+    void buildExecutionGraph() {
+        if (steps_ <= 0) {
+            return;
+        }
+
+        if (steps_ <= GRAPH_BATCH_STEPS) {
+            captureSteps(steps_, &batchGraph_, &batchGraphExecutable_);
+            batchLaunches_ = 1;
+        } else {
+            // An even-sized graph returns the ping-pong position buffers to
+            // their starting orientation, so it can be replayed without
+            // constructing an unbounded graph.
+            captureSteps(GRAPH_BATCH_STEPS, &batchGraph_, &batchGraphExecutable_);
+            batchLaunches_ = steps_ / GRAPH_BATCH_STEPS;
+            const int tailSteps = steps_ % GRAPH_BATCH_STEPS;
+            if (tailSteps != 0) {
+                captureSteps(tailSteps, &tailGraph_, &tailGraphExecutable_);
+            }
+        }
+
+        // Upload graph metadata before the benchmark interval, just like the
+        // device allocation and initial-state transfer above.
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGraphUpload(batchGraphExecutable_, stream_));
+        if (tailGraphExecutable_ != nullptr) {
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGraphUpload(tailGraphExecutable_, stream_));
+        }
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream_));
+    }
+
+    int count_ = 0;
+    int steps_ = 0;
+    double* deviceState_ = nullptr;
+    double* currentX_ = nullptr;
+    double* currentY_ = nullptr;
+    double* currentZ_ = nullptr;
+    double* nextX_ = nullptr;
+    double* nextY_ = nullptr;
+    double* nextZ_ = nullptr;
+    double* velocityX_ = nullptr;
+    double* velocityY_ = nullptr;
+    double* velocityZ_ = nullptr;
+    cudaStream_t stream_ = nullptr;
+    int batchLaunches_ = 0;
+    cudaGraph_t batchGraph_ = nullptr;
+    cudaGraphExec_t batchGraphExecutable_ = nullptr;
+    cudaGraph_t tailGraph_ = nullptr;
+    cudaGraphExec_t tailGraphExecutable_ = nullptr;
+};

Key changes:

- Unconditional CUDA execution with no CPU fallback.
- GPU-resident structure-of-arrays state and double-buffered positions.
- Warp-cooperative force calculation plus shared-memory tiling for very large workloads.
- Fused force/integration kernels using double precision.
- CUDA Graph batching to reduce launch overhead.
- Native GPU architecture compilation; executable remains `nbody`.
- No new files or dependencies.

Validation completed:

- Clean CMake/NVCC build.
- Default, zero-body, zero-step, large-dispatch, and graph-boundary tests pass.
- Maximum sampled numerical difference versus the serial implementation: approximately `5.1e-12` scaled.
- Compute Sanitizer: zero memory errors and zero race hazards.
- RTX 3090, 4,096 bodies × 10 steps: about `12 ms` versus `1,259 ms` serial—roughly 105× faster.

-void integrateBodies(std::vector<Body>& bodies) {

-        body.pos.y += body.vel.y * DT;

+// Small and medium problems do not contain enough bodies to occupy a modern
+// GPU with one thread per body. Here a power-of-two group of lanes cooperates
+// on each body's force and reduces its partial sums with warp shuffles.
+template <int LANES_PER_BODY, int BLOCK_SIZE>
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_SIZE)
+void advanceBodiesCooperative(const double* __restrict__ inX,
+                              const double* __restrict__ inY,
+                              const double* __restrict__ inZ,
+                              double* __restrict__ outX,
+                              double* __restrict__ outY,
+                              double* __restrict__ outZ,
+                              double* __restrict__ velX,
+                              double* __restrict__ velY,
+                              double* __restrict__ velZ,
+                              const int n) {
+    constexpr unsigned int FULL_WARP_MASK = 0xffffffffu;
+    const int globalThread = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * BLOCK_SIZE + static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+    const int bodyIndex = globalThread / LANES_PER_BODY;
+    const int lane = globalThread & (LANES_PER_BODY - 1);
+    const bool active = bodyIndex < n;
+    const double bodyX = active ? inX[bodyIndex] : 0.0;
+    const double bodyY = active ? inY[bodyIndex] : 0.0;
+    const double bodyZ = active ? inZ[bodyIndex] : 0.0;
+    double forceX = 0.0;
+    double forceY = 0.0;
+    double forceZ = 0.0;
+
+    if (active) {
+#pragma unroll 4
+        for (int j = lane; j < n; j += LANES_PER_BODY) {
+            const double dx = inX[j] - bodyX;
+            const double dy = inY[j] - bodyY;
+            const double dz = inZ[j] - bodyZ;
+            const double distanceSquared = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
+            const double inverseDistance = rsqrt(distanceSquared);
+            const double inverseDistanceCubed = inverseDistance * inverseDistance * inverseDistance;
+            forceX += dx * inverseDistanceCubed;
+            forceY += dy * inverseDistanceCubed;
+            forceZ += dz * inverseDistanceCubed;
+        }
+    }
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int offset = LANES_PER_BODY / 2; offset > 0; offset /= 2) {
+        forceX += __shfl_down_sync(FULL_WARP_MASK, forceX, offset, LANES_PER_BODY);
+        forceY += __shfl_down_sync(FULL_WARP_MASK, forceY, offset, LANES_PER_BODY);
+        forceZ += __shfl_down_sync(FULL_WARP_MASK, forceZ, offset, LANES_PER_BODY);
+    }
+
+    if (active && lane == 0) {
+        const double newVelocityX = velX[bodyIndex] + DT * forceX;
+        const double newVelocityY = velY[bodyIndex] + DT * forceY;
+        const double newVelocityZ = velZ[bodyIndex] + DT * forceZ;
+        velX[bodyIndex] = newVelocityX;
+        velY[bodyIndex] = newVelocityY;
+        velZ[bodyIndex] = newVelocityZ;
+        outX[bodyIndex] = bodyX + DT * newVelocityX;
+        outY[bodyIndex] = bodyY + DT * newVelocityY;
+        outZ[bodyIndex] = bodyZ + DT * newVelocityZ;
     }
 }

+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(velocityX_, hostVelX, componentBytes * 3,

+  private:
+    static constexpr int BLOCK_SIZE = 128;
+    static constexpr int GRAPH_BATCH_STEPS = 128;
+    // Three 150,000-element position arrays occupy 3.6 MB. Below this point
+    // they remain cache-friendly and a warp per body maximizes arithmetic
+    // occupancy; beyond it, explicit shared-memory tiling limits DRAM traffic.
+    static constexpr int COOPERATIVE_BODY_LIMIT = 150000;
+
+    template <int LANES_PER_BODY>
+    void launchCooperativeStep() {
+        const int bodiesPerBlock = BLOCK_SIZE / LANES_PER_BODY;
+        const int blocks = (count_ + bodiesPerBlock - 1) / bodiesPerBlock;
+        advanceBodiesCooperative<LANES_PER_BODY, BLOCK_SIZE><<<blocks, BLOCK_SIZE, 0, stream_>>>(
+            currentX_, currentY_, currentZ_, nextX_, nextY_, nextZ_,
+            velocityX_, velocityY_, velocityZ_, count_);
+    }
+
+    void launchStep() {
+        if (count_ <= COOPERATIVE_BODY_LIMIT) {
+            launchCooperativeStep<32>();
+        } else {
+            const int blocks = (count_ + BLOCK_SIZE - 1) / BLOCK_SIZE;
+            advanceBodiesTiled<BLOCK_SIZE><<<blocks, BLOCK_SIZE, 0, stream_>>>(
+                currentX_, currentY_, currentZ_, nextX_, nextY_, nextZ_,
+                velocityX_, velocityY_, velocityZ_, count_);
+        }
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+        std::swap(currentX_, nextX_);
+        std::swap(currentY_, nextY_);
+        std::swap(currentZ_, nextZ_);
+    }
+
+    void captureSteps(const int graphSteps, cudaGraph_t* graph, cudaGraphExec_t* executable) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamBeginCapture(stream_, cudaStreamCaptureModeThreadLocal));
+        for (int step = 0; step < graphSteps; ++step) {
+            launchStep();
+        }
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamEndCapture(stream_, graph));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGraphInstantiate(executable, *graph, nullptr, nullptr, 0));
+    }
+
+    void buildExecutionGraph() {
+        if (steps_ <= 0) {
+            return;
+        }
+
+        if (steps_ <= GRAPH_BATCH_STEPS) {
+            captureSteps(steps_, &batchGraph_, &batchGraphExecutable_);
+            batchLaunches_ = 1;
+        } else {
+            // An even-sized graph returns the ping-pong position buffers to
+            // their starting orientation, so it can be replayed without
+            // constructing an unbounded graph.
+            captureSteps(GRAPH_BATCH_STEPS, &batchGraph_, &batchGraphExecutable_);
+            batchLaunches_ = steps_ / GRAPH_BATCH_STEPS;
+            const int tailSteps = steps_ % GRAPH_BATCH_STEPS;
+            if (tailSteps != 0) {
+                captureSteps(tailSteps, &tailGraph_, &tailGraphExecutable_);
+            }
+        }
+
+        // Upload graph metadata before the benchmark interval, just like the
+        // device allocation and initial-state transfer above.
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGraphUpload(batchGraphExecutable_, stream_));
+        if (tailGraphExecutable_ != nullptr) {
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGraphUpload(tailGraphExecutable_, stream_));
+        }
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream_));
+    }
